title: Polish Sourdough Pasta
description: A fermented and fluffy Polish dish featuring bay leaves, made in a bain-marie for a low-calorie friendly meal
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sourdough starter, whole wheat flour, and salt, and mix until a shaggy dough forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest at room temperature for 2 hours
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a long rope
Cut the rope into 1-inch pieces to form the pasta
Place the pasta in a bain-marie and steam for 10 minutes
In a small bowl, whisk together egg whites and a pinch of salt
Brush the egg white mixture onto the cooked pasta
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with bay leaves
